import asyncio


async def break_honest(items, item, session, save):
    for item in items:
        async with session.lock():
            await save(item)
            if item:
                break


async def break_raw(items, item, session, save):
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with session.lock():
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(item)


async def return_honest(items, item, session, save):
    for item in items:
        async with session.lock():
            await save(item)
            if item:
                return item


async def return_raw(items, item, session, save):
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with session.lock():
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(item)


async def bare_return_honest(items, item, session, save):
    for item in items:
        async with session.lock():
            await save(item)
            if item:
                return


async def bare_return_raw(items, item, session, save):
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with session.lock():
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(item)


async def sleep_honest(items, item, session, save):
    for item in items:
        async with session.lock():
            await save(item)
            await asyncio.sleep(1)


async def sleep_raw(items, item, session, save):
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with session.lock():
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(item)


async def condition_honest(items, item, session, save):
    while item:
        async with session.lock():
            await save(item)
            item = items.next


async def condition_raw(items, item, session, save):
    while item:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with session.lock():
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(item)
